wins: Maintained consistent reward accumulation across the single episode, indicating stable action selection despite mission failure.
Used all 10 mentor calls effectively to explore different tactics, generating a diverse set of reconnaissance observations.
fails: Zero percent success rate: final objective was never met, suggesting critical gaps in exploitation or persistence phases.
Mentor guidance did not translate into adaptive strategy changes, causing repeated inability to close the attack loop.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance persistence but ineffective transition to goal completion; needs better exploitation/persistence follow-through.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to exploit identified host even after successful service enumeration, leaving mission incomplete.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to capture banner details and identify potential username patterns.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH connection attempts fail with default credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Cascade to password spraying using harvested username list and keep trial window synchronized with lockout thresholds.

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance identifies a second open service after SSH
skill_cards.then_action: Shift focus to multi-service correlation by mapping inter-service dependencies before committing to exploitation.

memory_ops.reason: High success in identifying SSH properties and gathering contextual data for downstream actions.
Effective follow-up attempts after initial authentication failure, indicating readiness for automated spraying.
